findings.title: Required legacy positive owner trajectory does not reach T6/T7
findings.description: The packet requires actual legacy and full preparation owners through successful T6 and START/PAUSE/RESUME/CONTINUE. The committed raw owner trajectory and full suite each fail test_owner_trajectories[legacy] at prepare_authorization_basis: validation.ref_s34_id points to owner-produced Nutrition, while demand.ref_s34_id points to Fitness. The unchanged legacy guard requires equality unless full_execution_members exists. Both snapshots and code independently establish the mismatch. Legacy COMMIT_READY and successful full execution cannot satisfy this required legacy positive oracle. This is a pre-existing consumer/packet compatibility gap, not a reason to weaken bindings or relabel denial PASS.
findings.required_action: Coordinator must ratify a scoped oracle refinement or assign a separately authorized legacy compatibility task, then produce successful required immutable-revision evidence and fresh review. No out-of-packet consumer fix is authorized by this review.
